subject: german

rounds.why: “Die Umwelt” means “the environment”. (Don't confuse it with “die Welt” = the world.)

truths: “Die Koffer packen” means “to pack the suitcases”.

rounds.lie: “Ich wohne am Stadtrand” means “I live in the city centre”.
rounds.why: “Der Stadtrand” means “the outskirts”. “City centre” is “die Stadtmitte / das Stadtzentrum”.
rounds.truth: “Ich wohne am Stadtrand” means “I live on the outskirts”.
truths: “Es gibt viel Umweltverschmutzung” means “There is a lot of pollution”.

rounds.lie: “Der Zug hat Verspätung” means “The train is early”.
rounds.why: “Verspätung” means “delay”, so the train is late/delayed. “Early” is “zu früh”.
rounds.truth: “Der Zug hat Verspätung” means “The train is delayed”.
truths: “Ein Doppelzimmer buchen” means “to book a double room”.

rounds.lie: “Wir sollten mehr recyceln” means “We recycled more”.
rounds.why: “Wir sollten” is the conditional “we should”. “We recycled” is “wir haben recycelt”.
rounds.truth: “Wir sollten mehr recyceln” means “We should recycle more”.
truths: “Die Umwelt schützen” means “to protect the environment”.

rounds.why: “Der Bildschirm” means “the screen”. (“Der Schirm” on its own can mean umbrella.)
truths: “Ich verbringe zu viel Zeit online” means “I spend too much time online”.

rounds.lie: “Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt” means “I used to live in the city”.
rounds.why: “Zurzeit” means “at the moment / currently”. “I used to live” is “früher habe ich gewohnt”.
rounds.truth: “Zurzeit wohne ich in der Stadt” means “At the moment I live in the city”.
truths: “Müll trennen” means “to separate the rubbish (for recycling)”.
